notablePrerequisites: You have at least one nonlegendary creature card exiled with Dino DNA.
description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating three token copies of a nonlegendary creature exiled with it that are 6/6 Dinosaurs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
